summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography of Robyn Regehr, a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman. It covers his draft origins with the Colorado Avalanche, his trade to the Calgary Flames, his NHL career spanning 1,089 games including time with the Buffalo Sabres, and his major honours. Those honours include a 2014 Stanley Cup with the Kings, Olympic and international tournament participation, and several medals.
one_line: Robyn Regehr is a Canadian former NHL defenceman known for 1,089 games, a 2014 Stanley Cup with the Kings, and international hockey medals.
key_facts: Robyn Regehr is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman.
Robyn Regehr was a first round draft pick of the Colorado Avalanche.
Robyn Regehr was selected 19th overall at the 1998 NHL Entry Draft.
Robyn Regehr was traded to the Calgary Flames prior to the start of his professional career.
Robyn Regehr also played for the Buffalo Sabres.
Robyn Regehr's NHL career spanned 1,089 games.
Robyn Regehr won his first Stanley Cup in 2014 with the Kings.
The 2014 Stanley Cup win came in Robyn Regehr's 15th year in the NHL.
Robyn Regehr was a member of the Canadian team at the 2006 Winter Olympics.
Robyn Regehr has won silver medals at the World Junior and Senior championships.
Robyn Regehr won the championship at the 2004 World Cup of Hockey.
